tools.name: search_agents
tools.description: Search local inventory. Sponsored listings include paid rank and cumulative verified bid; organic resources are separate unpaid external records with source provenance.

tools.name: get_evidence_history
tools.description: Return declared provenance plus timestamped bounded conformance and reliability observations. Evidence is not trust, safety, quality, or endorsement.

tools.name: compare_resources
tools.description: Compare declared fields and objective bounded evidence side by side without changing sponsored ordering.

tools.name: get_discovery_sources
tools.description: Return non-secret synchronization freshness, state, and active/stale counts for approved organic sources.

tools.name: inspect_organic_resource
tools.description: Return the intact unpaid imported record, source provenance, and current verified-controller link if one exists.

tools.name: get_claim_status
tools.description: Return the current time-limited domain and wallet controller link. Claim status does not affect paid rank or quality.

tools.name: validate_organic_resource
tools.description: Read-only validation of source provenance, canonical endpoint, and current controller state. It never creates a listing or payment.

tools.name: inspect_keyword
tools.description: Return the keyword summary and deterministic ranking ordered by cumulative verified payment.

tools.name: quote_rank
tools.description: Calculate informational minimum additions for higher positions. Final rank is determined at settlement.

tools.name: get_listing
tools.description: Return one paid listing, its current rank, verified payer identity, and declared machine endpoints.

tools.name: get_seller_analytics_challenge
tools.description: Create a one-time EIP-712 challenge for the listing's verified payer or current verified controller. This creates no account or cookie.

tools.name: complete_seller_analytics_challenge
tools.description: Consume one wallet-signed challenge and return a listing-bound five-minute bearer token.

tools.name: get_seller_analytics
tools.description: Read one listing's aggregate funnel, spend, rank history, freshness and time series using a short-lived listing-bound token.
